allow: Bash(cp .claude/settings.json /tmp/settings.want.json && git checkout -f develop 2>&1 && echo "---PULL---" && git pull --rebase origin develop 2>&1 | tail -5)

hooks.command: if ls src/*.sln* >/dev/null 2>&1; then if (cd src && dotnet test --nologo -v quiet); then echo 'TDD guard: all tests green'; else echo 'TDD guard: tests FAILING - commit blocked (fix or /add-test)' >&2; exit 2; fi; else echo 'TDD guard: no solution in src/ yet - skipping'; fi
hooks.statusMessage: Running dotnet test before commit (TDD guard)
